function.arguments:
{"code": "import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

rows = json.load(open("/tmp/moutai_kline.json"))
one_year = [r for r in rows if r[0] >= "2025-10-23"]

# columns: date, open, close, high, low, volume
df = pd.DataFrame(one_year, columns=["date","open","close","high","low","volume"])
for c in ["open","close","high","low","volume"]:
    df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c])
df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])

# Analysis stats
start_close = df["close"].iloc[0]
end_close = df["close"].iloc[-1]
chg_pct = (end_close - start_close) / start_close * 100
high_idx = df["high"].idxmax(); low_idx = df["low"].idxmin()
print("=== 贵州茅台 (600519) 近一年走势分析 ===")
print(f"区间: {df['date'].iloc[0].date()} ~ {df['date'].iloc[-1].date()}  (共{len(df)}个交易日)")
print(f"期初收盘: {start_close:.2f}  期末收盘: {end_close:.2f}")
print(f"区间涨跌幅: {chg_pct:+.2f}%")
print(f"区间最高: {df['high'].max():.2f} ({df['date'].iloc[high_idx].date()})")
print(f"区间最低: {df['low'].min():.2f} ({df['date'].iloc[low_idx].date()})")
print(f"期末相对最高回撤: {(end_close - df['high'].max())/df['high'].max()*100:.2f}%")

# monthly summary
df["ym"] = df["date"].dt.to_period("M")
monthly = df.groupby("ym").agg(首开=("open","first"), 末收=("close","last"), 最高=("high","max"), 最低=("low","min"), 成交量=("volume","sum"))
monthly["月涨跌幅%"] = (monthly["末收"]/monthly["首开"]-1)*100
print()
print(monthly.round(2).to_string())

# save cleaned df
df.to_pickle("/tmp/moutai_df.pkl")
print("\nsaved df")
"}
